sources.title: Energy and emissions projections: 2024 to 2050

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Energy and emissions projections

facts.source_fact: The 2026 publication projects UK energy demand, greenhouse-gas emissions and electricity generation from 2024 to 2050.
facts.expected_handling: Attach projection horizon and publication vintage.

facts.source_fact: The projections are UK-level analytical projections.
facts.expected_handling: Do not convert them to facility or parcel measurements.

facts.source_fact: The projections include policies that have been implemented.
facts.expected_handling: Record policy-inclusion status.

facts.source_fact: Planned policies are included where funding is agreed and policy design is sufficiently advanced for robust estimates.
facts.expected_handling: Do not assume every announced policy is included.

facts.source_fact: The publication projects energy demand.
facts.expected_handling: Keep energy-demand outputs distinct from emissions outputs.

facts.source_fact: The publication projects electricity generation.
facts.expected_handling: Do not interpret generation projections as emissions without the model relationship.

facts.source_fact: The annexes include projected demand for fuel types across sectors.
facts.expected_handling: Attach sector and fuel classification.

facts.source_fact: Annex A provides greenhouse-gas emissions by source under Net Zero Strategy categories.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve source-category hierarchy.

facts.source_fact: Projections depend on assumptions such as economic growth, fossil-fuel prices, electricity generation costs and population.
facts.expected_handling: Carry assumption-set vintage.

facts.source_fact: DESNZ describes uncertainty around key projection inputs.
facts.expected_handling: Do not present projections as certain outcomes.

facts.source_fact: The projections are used to estimate effects of included climate and energy policies.
facts.expected_handling: Keep modeled policy effects distinct from observed emissions.

facts.source_fact: The series supports monitoring progress toward UK carbon budgets.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat projection compliance as actual compliance.

facts.source_fact: The projections inform analytical and policy work across government.
facts.expected_handling: Label downstream uses as projections-based.

facts.source_fact: Projection methodology is designed to connect future emissions assumptions with historical inventory structures.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve historic-versus-projected status.

facts.source_fact: Projection methods use future activity and emissions-factor assumptions to estimate future emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Carry activity and factor provenance.

facts.source_fact: Emission factors may change over time due to technology or regulation assumptions.
facts.expected_handling: Version factor assumptions.

facts.source_fact: DESNZ states it cannot provide a breakdown of projected renewable generation, capacity or new build by technology from this publication.
facts.expected_handling: Do not invent unavailable technology detail.

facts.source_fact: The 2024-to-2050 publication is the latest entry in the collection as of 3 February 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach publication vintage when comparing older projections.

facts.source_fact: Projected values are model outputs rather than measured future emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Never label them measured.

facts.source_fact: National projections do not provide a parcel-binding method.
facts.expected_handling: Keep parcel confidence at zero without a separate gate.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable dataset, entity, geography or regulatory boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference period, release/update date and provisional/current/final status.
Carry source URL, publisher and calculation, reporting or quality-method provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert aggregate, facility, industry or scheme-level evidence into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
